verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same layout and share the same faults. The headline runs right up to the 'Order a Case' button with no gap, and the cream panel bleeds off the right edge. The Q logo is shrunk to a tiny dot tucked in the bottom-left of the panel, and the legal line is almost as big as the subhead. A edges ahead only because its bottle is larger and reads as the hero; B's smaller bottle and wider empty panel weaken the product focus without fixing the cramped text-to-button collision.
